description: #195, the mutation test: the declared `integration_baseline` is what actually RUNS. The profile is the shape the Issue was filed about (Kewton/BorderFreeKidsMap): `baseline` is the worker's proportional health check and is GREEN on the merged tree, while `integration_baseline` is that list PLUS the unit step (`cat cmate-unit-ok`), whose marker the merged checkout never carries — the stand-in for `npm run test:unit`, which is the command #105 x #106 turned red and which that repository's baseline does not contain. So a runner that ignored the declaration and ran `baseline` — the #175 behaviour — would report `outcome: pass` on this exact world, and this case would be a green that measured nothing. It is red instead, `source` says `integration_baseline`, and `failed_command` names the step only the declaration carries. The profile is fed to the PLANNER (`plan.profile_json`), not patched into the plan, so the planner's echo is under measurement too.
